title: KKR European Infrastructure RAIF III
investorTypes: Non-EU entity investors with multi-tier ownership chains
High-Risk Exposure investors (domiciled in or funding through a listed jurisdiction)
author: david.le

outcome.summary: Initial close held at 09:00 CEST on 2025-10-01 after a hotfix shipped the night before, when counsel lowered the UBO threshold to 10% for high-risk investors 48 hours before go-live.

incident: On 2025-09-29 at 08:40 CEST (13:40 ICT), three days after UAT sign-off and 48 hours before go-live, the Fund's Luxembourg counsel issued Revision 2 of the AML/KYC pack. For investors domiciled in, or routing capital through, a high-risk jurisdiction, it lowered the beneficial-ownership threshold from more than 25% to 10% or more and required recursive look-through up to 4 tiers (Section 5.2(c), Section 5.3). The v1 form had a static 3-row UBO table with 25% hard-coded and one look-through tier. 31 investor drafts were in progress, 7 of them affected, and 12 subscriptions were already signed.
rootCause: The threshold was encoded as a constant and as a fixed layout (3 rows, one look-through tier) instead of a parameter, and there was no migration path for in-flight drafts between schema versions, so a one-number counsel change became a structural rewrite.
resolution: David Le replaced the static table with the recursive repeater lux_aml_ubo_repeater_schema.json v2.0.0. It is driven by ubo_threshold_pct (25 by default, resolved to high_risk_threshold_pct 10, inclusive, for High-Risk Exposure investors) and max_depth 4, with an audit entry for the change. The migrate.v1_to_v2 rule moved all 31 drafts to the new schema with no data loss: 24 were left untouched and 7 were re-prompted only for 19 additional owner rows, as the pack's transitional clause (Section 7.2(a)) allows.
reusableRules: Never hard-code a regulatory threshold in a form; make it a parameter with an audit trail (who, approver, reason, source clause).
Model beneficial ownership as a recursive repeater with max_depth, never a fixed-row table; the row count is the threshold in disguise.
Version every form schema, pin drafts to their version, and ship changes with a migration rule that preserves entered values and re-prompts only the delta.
Keep the comparator with the threshold ('more than 25%' is exclusive, '10% or more' is inclusive) and test x-0.01, x and x+0.01.
Resolve the applicable threshold in exactly one rule from a dated high-risk list snapshot (EU Delegated Regulation 2016/1675 and FATF lists), re-evaluated when domicile or remitting account changes.
On counsel-led launches, ask counsel at kickoff about pending AML/KYC changes and secure a transitional clause so a mid-flight redline re-prompts only the delta.

artifacts.title: AML/KYC and Beneficial Ownership Due-Diligence Pack, Revision 2 (excerpt)
artifacts.description: Counsel's Revision 2 (29 Sep 2025) of the investor due-diligence pack applied by the AIFM. It covers simplified, standard and enhanced tiers, High-Risk Exposure (Section 3.2), PEP declarations, the 10% threshold (Section 5.2(c)), 4-tier recursive look-through (Section 5.3), source of funds and wealth, the transition for in-progress drafts (Section 7.2), and an Annex C UBO ownership-tree worked example.

artifacts.title: #deal-kkr-euro-infra-iii: counsel UBO redline, 48 hours to go-live
artifacts.description: Thread from the redline relay to go/no-go and the post-close summary. David explains how to change ubo_threshold_pct without breaking investor drafts (versioned schema, migration rule, re-prompt only affected drafts, inclusive vs exclusive comparator), followed by the QA plan and results.

artifacts.title: Post-mortem: Luxembourg UBO threshold redline (25% to 10%, 4-tier look-through)
artifacts.description: Timeline, the four design weaknesses the redline exposed, the root cause, the repeater, parameter and migration fix, impact (31 drafts, 0 values lost, 7 re-prompted, close held), and six reusable rules.

artifacts.title: Recursive UBO repeater schema v2.0.0 (parameterised threshold and depth)
artifacts.description: FundSub form schema for beneficial-ownership disclosure. It has ubo_threshold_pct, ubo_threshold_inclusive, high_risk_threshold_pct, max_depth and a dated high-risk list source; a recursive owner repeater (type, country, ownership %, control-only, PEP, children) with effective-% computation; validations for ownership sums, depth limit and threshold-triggered disclosure; Tier 4 escalation; and the migrate.v1_to_v2 draft-migration rule.
